qa.question: What workflow does the user want for getting LLM feedback on a highlighted section of a note?
qa.answer: Highlight a chunk, specify the type of advice, send it to the LLM, receive feedback and optionally a rewrite that can be applied only if approved.
evidence: D1:1: "I want to integrate llm to help me in this notes app where i can highlight a specific chunk (like a paragraph or something) and then send it to teh LLM and the LLM will give me feedbac. So i highlight, then tell the LLM what type of advice im looking for, and then send it to the LLM. the llm will return some feedback for me, and if relevant, a “rewrite’ block where i can click apply and rewrite the section i had highlighted with what the llm returned (but only if i approve of it). I can also send multiple chunks at a time.   There is no need to persist this data also, but if i click save it needs to save the note in the DB yes.   And also, lets say im doing an email draft. If im done with the note, i want to be abel to send it to google API gmail and have it send teh email for me. I should be able to specify the email i want to send  it to on my application and also probably need ot handle oauth to do my emails. I should be able to see the status of the email if ive sent it before on the actual note itself and also probably be able to track it in the calendar (since right now we track note update creations, so basically i need to be able to track to see which days i sent an emial etc.) so theres a new type."
